text:
The Beekeeper 2 - Official Red Band Teaser Trailer (2027) Jason Statham, Pom Klementieff
Check out the red band teaser trailer for The Beekeeper 2, an upcoming film sequel starring Jason Statham, Pom Klementieff, Jemma Redgrave, Emmy Raver-Lampman, Adam Copeland, Bobby Naderi with Yara Shahidi and Jeremy Irons.

Jason Statham is back as Adam Clay in The Beekeeper 2. Pulled back into the fight when the Beekeeper organization goes rogue and sets its sights on controlling the government, Clay must take on the very group that made him.

The Beekeeper 2 is produced by Jason Statham, Chris Long, p.g.a., and Kurt Wimmer. It is executive produced by Jonathan Glickman, Thom Zadra, Alexandra Loewy, Rachael Cole, and David Ayer. Co-producers are Anthony M. Scott, Spencer Ela, and Asa Sims. The screenplay is by Kurt Wimmer and Zak Penn. The story is by Kurt Wimmer.

The Beekeeper 2, directed by Timo Tjahjanto, opens in theaters on January 15, 2027.

Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse - How to Solve the Secret Organ Melody
When venturing across Notre Dame in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, you will find that Death has locked himself behind three life-draining beams. All three beams will require you to play a specific melody on the Great Organ in order to deactivate them. But there is a fourth melody for you to discover. Here is exactly how you can find it and what rewards you'll uncover.

When Sirens Fall Silent - Official Act 3 Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
Check out the latest trailer for When Sirens Fall Silent to see Act III: The Man. When Sirens Fall Silent is an upcoming dark, investigative, psychological thriller game. In When Sirens Fall Silent, you play as Mila, a determined policewoman in early 1990s Italy. ​Haunted by a past she's desperate to escape, Mila is thrust into a high-profile case of kidnappings and murders. As the investigation unravels, you must not only save her from herself, but also being swallowed up by a vortex of violence, mystery and confusion.

When Sirens Fall Silent will be available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG), Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5).

Wild Wild Eden - Official Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
Survive a primitive fantasy world in Wild Wild Eden. Check out this new trailer for Wild Wild Eden, an upcoming open-world survival crafting game where monsters are family. Pet, feed, and protect your companions. As a tribal chief, raise your monster friends, build a thriving base, and explore a harsh yet heartwarming world together. The new Wild Wild Eden trailer showcases gameplay, the game's monsters, known as Aidons, sleep taming, riding, farming, and a living food chain. Wild Wild Eden will be available in Early Access on PC in spring 2027.
